snippet.title: Pathogenic Trailer
snippet.description:
Pathogenic is a game about a parasite inside the human body that is fighting the immune system and trying to infect its human host. Think of it as the first stage of Spore turned into a roguelike. It is currently in development and targeting release by the end of the year.

Check out the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3808690/Pathogenic/

Join our discord at https://discord.gg/vKEek8PBA4
